Sarah Budd is the Chief Financial Officer at The Budd Group. Sarah earned her Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration from Furman University in 2013 and a Master’s in Accounting from Wake Forest University in 2014. Prior to joining The Budd Group, she gained valuable experience in public accounting at Grant Thornton.
